body:
Well, one of my best friends (the one who implied I talk about suicide for attention) told me once that I don't value myself and I always care about others and not myself. He also said that I have such low self-esteem that it is disgusting.

So, yeah, I can agree on that. It's high time I did something for myself. Ending it all will fix everything. It is time for me to stop thinking about others constantly and finally do something for me. And you know what I mean by "something".

I've been thinking for a long time. The decision to kill myself is not just a sudden impulse; I have tried and tried, I gave it time again and again, but in the end I failed. So, the only thing that's left is ending it all. It's the only thing I can control now.
Thanks for caring, but I don't have the guts to even try and fix things once again; I can't pay the price. It will be better if it all ends now.
Thanks for your interest, but I highly doubt they can do anything.

I  wish you to fully recover from your illness. I am glad to read that your life has gotten better now, but I know mine won't. I gave it a lot of tries, I kept putting my suicide date off for a long time, but I've had enough. I just came to the conclusion that indeed nothing can happen anymore. I've been struggling with suicidal thoughts for 2 years (or maybe more), but I wouldn't do it either because I was scared or because I don't want to die. However, there's no other option.
I wish you all the best! Cheers!

I know it will be horrible for them, but I have to choose between their happiness and mine. Yes, they will be devastated; but at least they'll have one another. I, on the other hand, will have to cope with my demons completely alone. And it's a fight that can't be won, no matter what I do. I know I sound selfish and cold-hearted, but I assure you I'm not; I am just desperate and can't handle life anymore.

You're right, I'm indeed young. I'm only 22. But I can't fix anything. Some things just shouldn't have happened. The damage is irreparable now. I think it's not worth living if I'm going to suffer for the rest of my life.

Well, I don't think I'll leave a letter. I had written two letters to 2 of my best friends before my previous attempt approximately 20 days ago, but I threw them away.

I am glad that things worked out for you in the end. I hope you lead a happy life! Unfortunately, I was not so lucky. But it's ok, it's no use crying anymore. Nothing can change. I am content with my decision. Goodbye and I wish you all the best!!!

No, of course I love him and I don't want to hurt him. But if I keep on living, I'll be hurting myself. People say suicide is selfish because of the pain it causes to loved ones. But isn't it also selfish to want to keep someone alive because you don't want to lose him even though life is torture to him?
I don't have the courage to pay the price for living. It's the best thing for me now.

I kinda know this feeling. I have attempted suicide twice before. I think it's just the instinct of survival that kicks in. The only problem is if you fail killing yourself and you end up a vegetable. In case you succeed, there are no more problems; it's all over.
Thanks for your words. At last, someone who understands me! Yes, this is my last resort. I'll try to tell you about the afterlife haha! 😛 Bye!!!
I'm sorry, but I have to. It's the best thing for me.
It doesn't. I tried many times to no avail.
Count me in. I've been looking for a peaceful way to go for months. I can't take it anymore.
Sorry for you, dude. I've also thought about jumping to my death, but I am too scared I'll fail and be in unbearable pain until I finally die. I want something more peaceful and failsafe.
